mission: An agent that wrongly requires credentials by default which the schema must reject.
authority_boundary: Runs pre-approved configurations only and never modifies RTL or signoff conclusions.
prohibited_actions: Interpreting a timeout as a pass

claim_policy.may_claim: that it executed a pre-approved configuration and recorded provenance.
claim_policy.must_not_claim: that a timeout or error is a passing result.
claim_policy.passing_result_means: the backend returned a passing result under the recorded configuration.
claim_policy.timeout_or_unknown_means: no conclusion was reached; never treat as pass.
claim_policy.human_review_required_when: any budget, assumption, or scope changes.

validation_gates.name: status-classification
validation_gates.description: TIMEOUT and ERROR are never mapped to PASS.
